continuation_rules: At handoff no audit role or coordinator subprocess is live. After this coordinator returns, root may run up to three separate q pipelines with workers=1, keeping root plus three fresh CLI roles within four active slots. Do not change host caps.

All 22 pending tasks use the default q/r/c and original audit.config.json. q hardcodes that config. Do not use the default helpers for special-config tasks; their own faithfulness/orchestration/q.py and c.py assert the task and select its config. Completed tasks must not be rerun.

q revalidates prepared artifacts, applies only released direct dependency reuse if no direct ledger exists, then runs fresh source, blind, direct, roundtrip and mechanically triggered adjudication, finalization and complete validation. Existing ledger entries must not be replaced by applying a second cache.

The exact released Python commands must run through native Python -B plus run_workflow_posix.py. Set FAITHFULNESS_AUDIT_CONFIG to the absolute POSIX /c/... config path for manual released validation; task-local q and c already set it.

Fresh CLI role sessions use --ignore-user-config --skip-git-repo-check --json --color never -C C:/Windows/Temp -s read-only, exact complete prompt/schema/packet stdin and only allowed source images. Never resume or fork a prior role. No model/effort overrides; record actual runtime UUID/model and null effort when unavailable.

Blind receives exactly the complete generated inputs/blind_review_packet.md and hash, with no source, user convention, native supplement, prior judgment, images or filesystem tools. r mechanically preserves this packet. Preflight can execute only r prefix before inp=tr/(stem+'_input.txt') to inspect ns[message]/ns[images]; never execute transport during preflight. Assert packet present once, no source/task/convention data, no images, and compare actual b_input hash with expected hash. Do not create b_input during preflight.

Source extraction reads the actual pinned PDF renderings only; direct sees exact source and full direct packet/inventory, roundtrip sees source and blind translation only, adjudicator receives both after mechanical triggers. No target proofs or historical classifications are supplied. For interpreted task helpers only direct/roundtrip/adjudicator receive the separately labeled user packet; native measure supplement goes only to direct/adjudicator.

Role c preserves exact raw JSON and actual CLI/runtime event logs, verifies one fresh UUID/turn/final and zero tool calls, then uses released record_agent_run and validate_agent_output. Inspect CLI item types for tool activity too; all completed roles here have agent_message items only. Collector runtime lookup is currently dated 2026/09/08; a future date requires a new additive helper, not an edit of a frozen helper.

Avoid redundant manual collection near automatic q boundaries. If a raw final exists without its canonical agent_output after a coordinator failure, collect it first with the correct c; do not invoke r again. Canonical output names use underscores: source_contract.json, blind_translation.json, direct_judge.json, roundtrip_judge.json, adjudicator.json. c refuses overwrites.

No blind dependency reuse: released compact_section can leak raw owner names and task-local identifiers. Direct reuse is allowed only under released exact setup/dependency checks, and fresh judges must resolve any origin-task D-number references against the complete current inventory. Eq07 records such a resolved reference. New special-config tasks used no meaning cache.
